title: Associated and weakly associated points agree locally Noetherianly
statement: Let X be a locally Noetherian scheme [pqf-def-locnoeth] and let O_X be its structure sheaf [def-pc-scheme]. The associated points of O_X are exactly its weakly associated points: Ass(O_X) = WeakAss(O_X). Here a point x is associated when the maximal ideal m_x of its local ring O_{X,x} is the annihilator of some element of O_{X,x}, and weakly associated when m_x is weakly associated to that local ring, meaning it is minimal among the prime ideals containing the annihilator of some element.

proof.text: Fix a point x and use set extensionality. The Mathlib instance in Mathlib/AlgebraicGeometry/Noetherian.lean makes the stalk R = O_{X,x} a Noetherian ring. Unfold Ideal.WeakAss: weak association of its maximal ideal p means that p is minimal over (bottom : Submodule R R).colon {a} for some a.

If p is the annihilator of a, use Ideal.minimalPrimes_eq_subsingleton_self for the prime ideal p to see that p is minimal over the same annihilator. This gives the forward implication with the same element a.

Conversely, given a with p minimal over (bottom : Submodule R R).colon {a}, apply Mathlib Submodule.exists_eq_colon_of_mem_minimalPrimes (Mathlib/RingTheory/Ideal/MinimalPrime/Colon.lean:31), using the Noetherian stalk instance. It supplies b with p = (bottom : Submodule R R).colon {b}, exactly association. This proves the reverse implication and hence the equality of point sets.
